name: china-subject-strength
title: Subject Strength of 16 Chinese Universities: GRAS 2026, ARWU Indicators and Highly Cited Researchers 2025
description: Subject Strength of 16 Chinese Universities: GRAS 2026, ARWU Indicators and Highly Cited Researchers 2025: Places of the 16 universities in all 57 GRAS 2026 subjects, top-10 counts by region, ARWU indicator means 2010-2025 and Highly Cited Researcher counts without names. The Long Bet, original research by M. Atamanova. Snapshot 2026-10-23.
